headline: Q1 Earnings Highs And Lows: Ralph Lauren (NYSE:RL) Vs The Rest Of The Consumer Discretionary - Apparel and Accessories Stocks
summary: Quarterly earnings results are a good time to check in on a company’s progress, especially compared to its peers in the same sector. Today we are looking at Ralph Lauren (NYSE:RL) and the best and worst performers in the consumer discretionary - apparel and accessories industry.
